0022600016.text: The Boston Celtics (2-1, 2-0 at home, second in the Atlantic and fifth in the East) host the Chicago Bulls (1-3, fourth in the Central and 11th in the East) in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group C game, with Boston on a two-game winning streak and Chicago having lost its last two. Devin Carter is out for Boston with an illness, and Nic Claxton is out for Chicago with a hamstring injury. Boston leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 134-99 win in Boston on October 26, and the Celtics also won the 2025-26 series 2-1.
